description: Request a change to who can do what on a DocType (role permissions, like the Role Permission Manager): grant or revoke rights for a role, or reset to standard; shows which users gain or lose which rights; always needs a second approver

operation.description: grant: add rights (the rule is created when missing). revoke: remove the listed rights, or the whole rule when rights is empty. reset: back to the DocType's standard permissions

doctype.description: Exact DocType name (not a child table, not User/Role/permission/code/settings DocTypes)

role.description: Exact Role name; grant/revoke only. Never Administrator

rights.description: grant: rights to give. revoke: rights to take (empty = remove the role's rule)

permlevel.description: Field level the rule applies to; default 0 (the document). Level > 0 needs a level 0 rule for the role and only takes read/write

if_owner.description: 1 = only documents the user created (Frappe's 'Only If Creator')

allow_automatic_role.description: Set 1 only when the user explicitly named Guest, All or Desk User

purpose.description: One line: why the user wants it (shown on the card)
